title: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art Delhi | Timings, Entry Fee, History & Travel Guide
content:
Kiran Nadar Museum of Art - Delhi, 

The Kiran Nadar Museum of Art (KNMA) was established in 2010 by art collector and philanthropist Kiran Nadar. Located in Saket and Noida, this museum has quickly become a cultural landmark in Delhi NCR.

KNMA houses over 5,000 artworks, including masterpieces by celebrated Indian artists like M.F. Husain, Raja Ravi Varma, F.N. Souza, Tyeb Mehta, and Anish Kapoor. The museum is known for its temporary exhibitions, workshops, talks, and interactive sessions that make art engaging for all ages.

What makes this museum unique is its focus on Indian modern and contemporary art, bridging the gap between traditional culture and present-day creativity. Visitors can explore not only paintings but also multimedia art, installations, and experimental projects.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Saket & Noida, Delhi NCR
  • Timings: 10:30 AM – 6:30 PM (Closed on Mondays)
  • Entry Fee: Free for all visitors
  • Photography: Allowed (but avoid flash photography)

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: The nearest metro station is Malviya Nagar (Yellow Line) for Saket branch, and Okhla Bird Sanctuary (Magenta Line) for Noida branch.
  • By Bus/Auto: Easily accessible by DTC buses and autos from South Delhi.
  • By Car: Both museums are located in prime areas with good road connectivity.

Parking Information: Paid parking is available at nearby malls and complexes.

Best Time to Visit: The museum can be visited throughout the year, but October to March is the most pleasant season for exploring Delhi’s cultural spaces. Weekday mornings are best for a quieter experience.

Nearby Places to Visit:

  • Select Citywalk Mall (Saket - shopping & dining).
  • Garden of Five Senses - (perfect for a nature walk).
  • Qutub Minar - (UNESCO World Heritage Site).
  • Lotus Temple - (famous Bahaí House of Worship).

Travel Tips: Carry a notebook or use your phone to jot down names of artists you like - you’ll discover some hidden gems at KNMA that you may want to explore later.
excerpt: The Kiran Nadar Museum of Art (KNMA) in Delhi is India’s first private museum dedicated to modern and contemporary art. With its vibrant collection of paintings, sculptures, and installations, the museum is a paradise for art lovers. It’s not just a gallery but also a cultural hub where creativity and learning meet.
